title: Interview demo · purple sandbox button and live Muse activity
summary: The homepage hero's Try Our Sandbox button changes from rust to purple. Its destination stays /demo. Office adds a pulsing activity light beside workflow coverage, backed by authenticated Muse check-ins and current-build work. Older text evidence opens without crashing.
source: Committed review plan for this interview demonstration.

scenarios.title: Compare the sandbox button color
scenarios.description: Only the homepage hero's Try Our Sandbox button changes color.
scenarios.instructions: Toggle Original and Changed. Compare the large Try Our Sandbox button beneath the headline.
scenarios.expected: Original is rust (#a83e1d). Changed is purple (#7041b8), with white readable text and the same label, size and position.
steps: Original shows the rust hero button.
Changed shows the purple hero button with readable white text.

scenarios.title: Check hover, keyboard focus and sandbox entry
scenarios.description: The color change must preserve the existing sandbox journey.
scenarios.instructions: In Changed, hover the hero button and use Tab to focus it. Activate it and confirm sandbox entry loads. Use Reset item to return to the homepage.
scenarios.expected: Hover is darker purple (#56318f), focus remains visible, and activation opens /demo.
steps: Hover and keyboard focus are clear.
The button opens the existing sandbox entry without an error.

scenarios.title: Inspect the Muse activity light
scenarios.description: A new status light sits directly beside the colored workflow boxes.
scenarios.instructions: Compare Original and Changed at workflow coverage. Local previews do not run Muse: Changed should show an unavailable or idle state, never a fabricated active pulse. After publishing, open the live Office to watch actual Muse claims and verdicts.
scenarios.expected: Changed has a labeled light. It pulses only with a fresh authenticated Muse check-in plus active checks on this build. Reduced-motion mode uses a steady light.
steps: The activity indicator is visible beside the coverage boxes.
The local preview does not claim that Muse is actively testing.

scenarios.title: Open an existing workflow's evidence
scenarios.description: Older evidence may be plain text rather than an attachment list.
scenarios.instructions: In Changed, click an existing colored or historical workflow box, read its details, and close the dialog.
scenarios.expected: The workflow details open without crashing. Existing text evidence remains readable.
steps: Workflow details open and close without an error page.
